column1: # *** THE THREE DEVON ADDRESSES - tested 17 September 2026, and only one of them is reachable free. ***
# Work-list row 123. The current tree supplies three street addresses the archive lacked, and the row's
# premise was that *** "an address is what a census is searched on." *** That is true of a paid census
# and NOT true of the free one.

column2: Agnes Walker Taylor, born there *** 3 August 1889 ***
column3: *** CONFIRMED, and from a census rather than the tree. *** The 1891 return for the household - *** piece 1787, ED 4, folio 42, page 1, schedule 2 *** - gives the house number and street as *** "2, Fore Street" ***. So the tree's birth address is the family's actual address two years later. *** And it sits a few doors from 26 FORE STREET, where Mary Septima stayed with her sister Edie in 1935. ***

column2: Horace Archibald Taylor, born there *** April 1872 ***
column3: *** NOT TESTABLE FREE. *** The census that would show it is *** 1871 or 1881 ***, and FreeCEN holds *** neither *** for Bideford - its coverage there is 1851, 1861 and 1891 only.

column2: Lucy Elizabeth Taylor, born there *** 4 August 1881 ***
column3: *** NOT TESTABLE FREE, for the same reason. *** FreeCEN holds Northam for 1851, 1861 and 1891; the family is at Fore Street by 1891, so the 1881 return is the one that matters and it is not there.

column1: # *** AND THE LARGER POINT, WHICH IS ABOUT THE TOOL AND NOT ABOUT THE FAMILY. ***
# *** FreeCEN CANNOT SEARCH BY ADDRESS AT ALL. *** Its form offers last name, first name, birth years,
# county, place, census year, marital status, sex, occupation and disability. *** There is no address
# field, and no free text. *** An address can only ever be READ OFF a return that a NAME search found -
# which is exactly how 2 Fore Street was confirmed above.
# *** So the row's method - "these three should place the household without a name search" - only works
# on a paid census (findmypast, Ancestry) or the 1939 Register, and the archive already holds those
# through other hands. *** Recorded so the row is not re-attempted on FreeCEN a third time.
